book.name: Mark
book.title: Mark ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Awamooasoo soo mu Jew numu tutunehanedu ka Te Pabe'e batsakwu mee tunehane. Yise ka Te Pabe'e mi tzakunase, ka teepu-kooba katudu naa, Pilate mee naneadu-kobena oo tzaka petuga.
Soo Pilate mee ka Te Pabe'e tubenga, “U haa'a ka mu Jew numu-kooba katukwudu?” Soo Te Pabe'e oo nekwege'a, “Aha, nu yow oosoo.”
Mu Jew numu tutunehanedu mee ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “Ewa u suda manakwe.”
Soo Pilate yise mee ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “Umu tooe hayoo tooe u netamma. U haa'a gi oo naka, o'no u gi hayoo unakwe?”
Pana soo Te Pabe'e gisoo tuwazoo hayoo sukwe unakwe. Soo Pilate meeoo soonamme, “Nu gi o nakasopedakwatoo ha'oo mane-naga masoo gi mu nanekwege'a.”
Nonotsa sumu tomoyina tu na'ewa tukano'o soo numu-kooba katudu sumuoo mu nakwutumadu-matu tzama'wuyakwe, ka mu numu unne-makoosoo.

Ewa'yoo mu numu ka Pilate-baa petuse, yise meeoo oo netamma, “U sakwa sumuoo mu nakwutumadu-matu tzatsebooe.” Soo Pilate oo nesopedakwatoo ka Jew tutunehanedu gi Te Pabe'e soobetzabena, ooonne'yoona yise mu numu tutunehanedu ka Te Pabe'e wutuma. Soo Pilate meeoo mu tubenga, “Mu haa'a ka Mu Pabe'e Jesus tzama'wukwu?” Mu Jew numu tutunehanedu meeoo mu numu netamma, “Mu sakwa ka Pilate ka Barabbas tzatsebooe tuungu.” Oosoo nana, Barabbas mee naneadu, tu pupuamu-no nakwutumadu. Umu ka mu Roman numu-no nanagoena, susumudu mu numu-matu nagoehoo.
Soo Pilate mu numu mee netamma, “Esoo nana nu-baa petu, mu Jew Numu-kooba Katudu mee naneadu. How yise nu oo yugwekwu?”
Mu numu wa'agemo'o, “Oo tzakwenne. Oo batsa.”
Soo Pilate mee mu netamma, “How tubetse suda oosoo manakwe?” Mu numu pabasoo wa'agemo'o, “Oo batsa.”
Soo Pilate gi oo nebatsapana, yise mu numu puusoo oo nebatsana. Soo Pilate yise ka Barabbas, ka mu tukwutumadu tzama'wu tuunguse, ka Te Pabe'e wupagetase oo batsa, pa'a oo taposa mee tunetamma.
Mu tukwutumadu ka Te Pabe'e, ka Pilate nobe-kwitoo tzakaka. No'yoona mu tukwutumadu oe sumuhoobetu.
Umu numu-kobena'yoona o wunaga'ayaakuhoo, mono-ga-kwi oo tzowupagaku.
Umu oo-ma'yoona naneko'ena, oo nematzamana, mee oo netamma, “U tookwa yow Jew Numu-kooba Katudu.”
Umu hooope-ma oo kwo-makoo oo wupagetana, oo kobitoo toohena, o-kobena meatzedona oo nasootzamekuna, oo-ma'yoona nanekoena.
Umu Te Pabe'e nanetza'mekumakwuse, oo namasooapu-wisoo oo matabue. Umu yise ka Te Pabe'e tsakakase, oo batsakwu.
Umu tukwutumadu ka meadabena, Simon
mee naneadu wegeahoo. Mu tukwutumadu ka Simon nenoyukwe ka Te Pabe'e puma nataposakwuna oo tzano tuunguna.
Ka Te Pabe'e Numu Tzonoho mee naneadu-kwi o bi petuga.
Yise umu atsa tutza'emukwa baa, noko natusooabe mayuana oo tooe hebe tuungu, soo Te Pabe'e yise gi oo hepe.
Yise awamooa umu oo mi-makoo pa'a oo taposa. Mu tukwutumadu yise oo kwasu nanatotsakwate.
Ka sunngabe namadabue-ma puma oo nataposana meeoo natubo'o, “Yow esoo Jew Numu-kooba Katudu.”
Waha'yoo tutuduhadu punno'o ka Te Pabe'e na'enakwana nataposa.
Mu numu oo-moopa meagonnona, oo-ma'yoo naneko'e mee unnena, “U meeoo unnepu, u Te Naa nobe wudyoomase, pahe tabewa-wi besa oo matabuekwusoo.
U sakwa ka unu tumadina mama'yoo wuekese, uusoo namagwetzoi.”
Umu numu tutunehanedu oo-ma'yoo naneko'e mee unnena, “U mu numu magwetzoise, pana yise gi hownnekoo uusoo namagwetzoi-wa'ne'yoo.

Hownne'yoo Ne Pabe'e U? Gi hownnekoo uusoo namagwetzoi-wa'ne'yoo, ka naduyana mee unnepana. Uusoo yaa teepu-matoo wuese, numme u naka'oedyukukwu.” Umu punno'o oo na'enakwa nataposadu oo-ma'yoo naneko'e.
Tabeno manakwana oona ka taba pahe-kwikoo tooe, ka teepu-koobakwitu toganopunne.
Pahe-kwikoo tapuakese soo Te Pabe'e paba wa'age yadooa, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani,” mee na'unnedu, “Nuga Naa, Nuga Naa, How manena u e matusookwuna'e?”
Umu susumudu o konnopunnedu-nagatu mee unne, “Masoo tookwa ka Elijah, o'nosoo Te Naa yadooawabe mee naneadu bidyakwe.”

Sumu'yoo umu-nagatu yabesoo tanomanegase, yise yotsogadu wanapu, suda kammadu baa oodutsekoo hooope-ma oo tzetzabekuse, ka Te Pabe'e tzatumakute. Pana mu susumudu meeoo, “Oo tsasoopedya. Sumuna soo Elijah tamme-baa tabua petuse oo magwetzoikwu.”
O'no soo Te Pabe'e paba wa'agese, ya'eoo.

Soo tukwutumadu ka Te Pabe'e poonne ka oo ya'ehoose, mee yise unne, “Masoo tookwa too'e togesapa ka Te Naa Tooa'a.” Soo wunapu ka Te Naa pooha pukwi'yoona numu nanesootuhidu-makoo naamootoo natzakwenedu, ka Te Pabe'e ya'ehoose, soo wunapu pa'anakwana tubongo oo naamootoo natzagebu'ehoo. Soo teepu yutsungakoohase, mu tupe payooagonnona sawekooha.

Ewa'yoo momoko'ne punno'o onow kwina'a konnopunnena oo poonnepunne, umuoo ka Galilee-wi'yoona ka Te Pabe'e-no kemmapu oo tummatzina. Umuoo momoko'ne-nagatu pahe'yoo, Mary Magdalene, yise Mary mu James noko Joseph pea, yise tuwazoo Zebedee nodukwa.

Soo nana, Joseph mee naneadu, Arimathea-wikoo nobe-ga'yoo, ka numu tutunehanedu-matu, unu napetzabedu. Toogoopatu Te Naa ka teepu besa oo yugwekwunu wutooedu. Ka tu pudu yongoga'a soo Joseph ka Pilate nobe-kwi petuga yise oo tubenga, “How sakwa u ka Te Pabe'e tookoo e tzagea?”
Soo Pilate mee unakwe, “Soo Jesus haa'a tubetse ya'epu?” Soo tukwutumadu nabise, yise natubenga, “Soo Jesus tubetse ya'epu haa'a?” Soo tukwutumadu, “Aha,” mee unakwe.
Yise ka tukwutumadu nakase, soo Pilate ka Joseph mee oo netamma, “Yise a haneka.”
Soo Joseph yise ka Te Pabe'e tookoo tzakwekuse toha wunapu hane petuse, oe oo manobea. Tupe tuwaga-kwi oo tugu. Pabow tupe o-kobenatoo tonanooehoo.
Umu Mary Magdalene-no, Joseph pea Mary mee naneadu, ka Te Pabe'e natugu-kwitu poonnepunne.

footnotes.text: Esoo nana oo natzano tuungudu, Simon mee naneadu. Oo doodooamu Alexander noko Rufus mee nananeadu. Cyrene mee naneadu-kwi tubewa-ga'yoo.
